title: Coordinator-authorized ephemeral run enrollment
status: Design and offline-test contract only. No live enrollment authority has been configured or approved.
goal: A WorkOS-authenticated coordinator automatically enrolls ephemeral runs within a human-approved grant. Each worker holds only its own short-lived key-bound access; permission expansion still requires the human website.
identity_claim: This proves coordinator authorization and key possession. It is not provider attestation of a unique VM, container, thread, or computer.

trusted: WorkOS token validation for the MCP coordinator
Broker grant/decision registry and isolated runtimes
The approved coordinator connection, within the exact standing grant
The worker-generated private key remaining confidential in that run
untrusted: Worker-supplied labels, thread IDs and environment IDs
Arbitrary requested roles, accounts and lifetimes
Tool arguments claiming owner, coordinator, client or approval authority
current_limits: Custom broker MCP is not deployed or connected
Real ChatGPT/Claude enrollment tool-confirmation behavior is not tested
Fresh saved-cloud task creation has failed in the current session
No platform per-launch credential channel or Pro workload attestation is established
Existing workers may not acquire newly installed plugins without a new session

human_approval_fields: Verified WorkOS issuer and owner subject
Exact logical role and active physical revision or approved bundle
AWS account, regions, actions, resources and conditions
Maximum run age, token age and AWS session duration
Temporary absolute cutoff or ongoing-until-revoked with owner and review date
Whether child enrollment is permitted and whether local credential vending is permitted
never_inferred: A WorkOS login is not an AWS permission grant
MCP scopes are not a replacement for app-owned entitlement checks
A key supplied by a worker is not an approved authority
A connection to WorkOS management MCP is not a connection to the broker

flow.action: Generate a fresh signing key in run-local private storage. Return only the public JWK and thumbprint.
constraints: Never bake private keys into environment snapshots, source archives or plugin configuration
A reused or cloned filesystem is not a new physical-machine proof
Use a maintained crypto library and operating-system randomness

flow.action: Call prepare_run_enrollment with grant ID/revision, public JWK, bounded requested lifetime, nonsecret label and idempotency key.
server_checks: Validate OAuth signature, issuer, audience, expiry and exact coordinator client/connection
Resolve owner and permitted bundle server-side
Require an active human-approved standing enrollment and vending grant
Atomically bind the public-key thumbprint, grant revision/digest, account, bundle, cutoff and principal provenance
No caller-supplied owner, approval, unrestricted role ARN or token passthrough

flow.action: Return only nonsecret enrollment ID, one-use short-lived challenge, key thumbprint, expiry and authority summary.
constraints: No private key, WorkOS access/refresh token, broker workload token or AWS credential in content, structuredContent, _meta, URLs or logs
Enrollment is a mutating tool and must be annotated accurately; do not suppress client confirmation by labelling it read-only

flow.actor: Local helper over direct broker HTTPS
flow.action: Prove possession of the pending enrollment key and redeem the enrollment.
server_checks: Bind proof to server audience, exact method/path, pending enrollment ID and server nonce
Require fresh proof ID/time and atomic nonce consumption
Recheck unchanged active grant revision/digest and coordinator binding
Create at most one logical run lease; safe recovery from a lost response must not create a second lease or accept another key

flow.action: Return a short-lived key-bound workload token only to the local helper.
constraints: If using OAuth DPoP, implement RFC 9449 including cnf.jkt binding and htm/htu/iat/jti/ath validation; do not call an ad hoc signature protocol DPoP-compliant
Broker-issued tokens have a distinct configured issuer/audience and cannot authenticate to the MCP or human approval endpoints
Renewal is bounded by the fixed run lease and current grant; it cannot extend the maximum lifetime or expand the bundle

flow.action: Request temporary AWS credentials for one approved role using the workload token and fresh proof.
server_checks: Require active run, connection and grant; exact physical revision and scope binding
Reject unauthorized role selection or stale/superseded policy baseline
Respect STS minimum duration and role chaining; do not promise arbitrary sub-15-minute STS expiry
Bound effective permission cutoff to the approved grant/run and isolate physical revisions
Use a separate assume-only runtime identity
delivery: Return credentials over TLS directly to the local helper
Emit the AWS credential_process JSON only into the consuming AWS SDK/CLI pipe
Never send credential JSON through MCP or general status endpoints
Redact secret-bearing provider responses and exceptions

flow.action: Expose only run/lease/issuance metadata for status, renewal and revocation.
constraints: Grant, connection or run revocation stops future issuance immediately at the broker
Already-issued STS credentials are separately bounded; emergency AWS revocation is not equivalent to stopping issuance
A copied private key can impersonate the same run until revocation/expiry; per-run identity does not prove non-cloning
Coordinator renewal is automatic within the approved standing grant but remains subject to the client platform's own action-confirmation policy

required_negative_tests: MCP tool input cannot forge owner, actor kind, client ID, approved state or AWS role authority
Same-owner CLI/MCP token rejected by human approval endpoint
Revoked, expired, missing or changed grant rejected before enrollment and again at redemption
Prepare retry with identical idempotency key/body has one logical effect; changed body/key conflicts
Wrong private key cannot redeem public enrollment metadata
Expired challenge, reused nonce, reused proof jti, wrong method/path/audience and stale proof rejected
Concurrent redemption produces one run lease; lost-response recovery cannot broaden or duplicate it
Run token copied without the signing key cannot vend
Private-key substitution and key change after prepare rejected
Requested lifetime, role, region or resource outside the standing grant rejected
Run, connection and grant revocation all stop renewal and vending
Grant supersession cannot revive old sessions or change their physical role revision
STS remaining lifetime below provider minimum is handled explicitly, not silently rounded beyond approved cutoff
MCP content/structuredContent/_meta/errors, audit logs and artifact archives contain no credential bodies or private keys
Status/query endpoints do not mutate grants, journal or reservation state
External network denial is distinguished from auth/IAM denial

client_acceptance_gates.surface: ChatGPT plugin in a new conversation
checks: Connect broker through WorkOS using observed CIMD/DCR metadata
Harmless authenticated get_profile has stable subject across refresh/reconnect
Prepare enrollment passes only public key and exact existing grant
Confirm actual write-tool prompts and policy behavior; no promise of prompt-free enrollment until tested
Fresh worker receives public enrollment metadata and proves its own key directly
No AWS/WorkOS secrets appear in tool transcript
client_acceptance_gates.status: Not run; requires hosted broker and approved connection

checks: Connect remote Streamable HTTP MCP with OAuth, no pasted shared secret
Verify public-client callback/PKCE and supported registration path from actual client version
Repeat the public-key handoff, key-bound direct vending and revocation tests
Restart/reconnect and refresh retain correct coordinator identity
client_acceptance_gates.status: Not run; requires hosted broker and approved connection

checks: Validate initialize, tools/list, tool schemas, structured output and auth challenge behavior
Use offline tokens/keypairs and stubbed AWS providers only
Run all negative cases without contacting real WorkOS/AWS
client_acceptance_gates.status: Implementation target for current non-live slice

deployment_approval_prerequisites: Exact hosted broker origin and TLS
Exact WorkOS custom app/client and token contracts
Initial broker MCP connection and bounded standing enrollment grant
Exact AWS trust/boundary/role resources and read-only EC2 inventory
Environment networking for the broker and explicitly needed AWS service endpoints
Secure server-side keys/storage and runtime isolation
Cost, rollback, cleanup and live positive/negative test plan
